dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extents between 03 and 23 August 2022 over Pakistan
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20220808PAK** This map illustrates cumulative satellite-detected water using VIIRS in Pakistan between 03 to 23 August 2022. Within the cloud free analyzed areas of about 780,000 km2, a total of about 55,000 km2 of lands appear to be affected with flood waters. Based on Worldpop population data and the maximum flood water coverage, ~19,368,000 people are potentially exposed or living close to flooded areas. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
